Do you mean a project named “Project‑X,” or are you asking me to design/plan/brainstorm something called Project‑X? I can take many directions — pick one or tell me more:

Quick options I can do right now
- Draft a one‑page project brief (vision, goals, target users, success metrics).  
- Create a 30/60/90‑day roadmap + milestones.  
- Build a technical spec / system architecture (tech stack, API surface, data model).  
- Generate a Git repo scaffold (folders, README, CI) and starter files.  
- Produce a pitch deck outline (problem, solution, market, go‑to‑market, ask).  
- Create an initial backlog (Epics → User Stories → Tasks) and Kanban setup.  
- Brainstorm product ideas / alternate names / branding.  
- Run a risk register + mitigation plan and cost estimate.

If you don’t care which, I’ll start with a one‑page brief + 30/60/90 roadmap for Project‑X. To make it useful, tell me a few quick constraints if you have them:
- Domain or industry (web app, ML, mobile, hardware, research, art, etc.)
- Audience or users
- Team size and skills available
- Deadline or target launch window
- Any tech preferences or restrictions

Reply with the option number (or “surprise”), or give details and I’ll begin.
